metadata.question: Does the valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decrease from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Upper Arrow Lake area (British Columbia, Canada) - approximately 49.5°N, 117.3°W - Date: October 22, 2018 - Need: Morning and afternoon imagery to compare fog coverage - Collection: Sentinel-2 (high temporal resolution, useful for intra-day analysis) - Challenge: Sentinel-2 has limited daily passes; may need to check if multiple passes exist on the same day, or use Landsat 8 2. **Masking strategy**: - This question is specifically about fog coverage, so we should NOT mask clouds/fog as typical cloud masking would - Instead, we need to identify fog/low-visibility conditions using spectral indices or cloud probability - Morning vs. afternoon comparison requires intra-day temporal data - Fog can be detected using NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or cloud probability bands - Use `QA60` band for Sentinel-2 or cloud probability to identify low clouds/fog 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error**: - Valid zero (B answer): Fog coverage measured at both times; shows no decrease or increases - Valid decrease (A answer): Morning fog > Afternoon fog - C1: No valid imagery for October 22, 2018 in the region - C2: Images exist but all pixels masked out or outside bounds - C3: Calculation fails (NaN, invalid cloud percentage, etc.) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Upper Arrow Lake area const upperArrowLake = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-117.5, 49.4, -117.1, 49.6]); // October 22, 2018 const date = '2018-10-22'; const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // Sentinel-2 collection for the date const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(upperArrowLake) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8', 'B11', 'QA60']) .filterMetadata('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'less_than', 95); const imageCount = s2.size().getInfo(); print(`Total Sentinel-2 images on Oct 22, 2018: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { print("No Sentinel-2 imagery available for October 22, 2018."); print("C1"); return; } // Extract images and sort by time const imageList = s2.toList(s2.size()); const images = []; for (let i = 0; i < imageCount; i++) { const img = ee.Image(imageList.get(i)); const timestamp = img.getNumber('system:time_start').getInfo(); images.push({ img: img, time: new Date(timestamp), idx: i }); } // Sort by acquisition time images.sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time); print(`Image times (UTC):`); images.forEach((d, i) => { print(` ${i}: ${d.time.toUTCString()}`); }); if (imageCount < 2) { print("Only 1 image found; cannot compare morning vs afternoon."); print("C1"); return; } // Use first image as morning, last as afternoon const morningImg = images[0].img; const afternoonImg = images[imageCount - 1].img; // Function to calculate fog coverage using cloud probability // Fog = high NIR reflectance + low NDVI + high cloud probability function calculateFogCoverage(image) { const B2 = image.select('B2'); const B3 = image.select('B3'); const B4 = image.select('B4'); const B8 = image.select('B8'); const B11 = image.select('B11'); const QA60 = image.select('QA60'); // Cloud probability (bit 10 and 11 of QA60 indicate clouds) const cloudMask = QA60.bitwiseAnd(1024).eq(0).and(QA60.bitwiseAnd(2048).eq(0)); // NDVI for fog detection (fog has low NDVI) const NDVI = B8.subtract(B4).divide(B8.add(B4)); // Cloud reflectance: blue and red bands high const cloudReflect = B3.add(B4).divide(2); // Fog indicator: high reflectance + low NDVI + cloudy const fogIndicator = cloudReflect.multiply(cloudMask.float()).where(NDVI.gt(0.3), 0); // Count pixels with fog signal const fogCount = fogIndicator.reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: upperArrowLake, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 } ).get('B2'); const totalCount = cloudMask.reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: upperArrowLake, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 } ).get('B2'); return { fogCount: fogCount, totalCount: totalCount }; } const morningFog = calculateFogCoverage(morningImg); const afternoonFog = calculateFogCoverage(afternoonImg); const morningFogCount = morningFog.fogCount.getInfo(); const afternoonFogCount = afternoonFog.fogCount.getInfo(); const totalPixels = morningFog.totalCount.getInfo(); print(`Morning fog pixels: ${morningFogCount} / ${totalPixels}`); print(`Afternoon fog pixels: ${afternoonFogCount} / ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0 || morningFogCount === null || afternoonFogCount === null) { print("No valid pixels for comparison."); print("C2"); return; } const morningCoverage = (morningFogCount / totalPixels) * 100; const afternoonCoverage = (afternoonFogCount / totalPixels) * 100; print(`Morning fog coverage: ${morningCoverage.toFixed(2)}%`); print(`Afternoon fog coverage: ${afternoonCoverage.toFixed(2)}%`); print(`Decrease: ${(morningCoverage - afternoonCoverage).toFixed(2)}%`); if (isNaN(morningCoverage) || isNaN(afternoonCoverage)) { print("C3"); return; } if (morningCoverage > afternoonCoverage) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
